card.name: Linking words before infection or disease terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words and punctuation (of developing, or, become, an opening parenthesis, and) in medical text where a disease or infection term such as GVHD, an infection name, or a lesion description is expected next.

modes.label: Verb or link before a complication
modes.description: A verb such as developing or become right before a named complication or lesion state.
modes.example: are at increased risk of<< developing>> GVHD after RETHYMIC if

modes.label: Or/and/parenthesis in disease lists
modes.description: An 'or', 'and' or opening parenthesis inside a list of findings or infections, just before the next disease term.

card.writes: It pushes down infection words such as infection, infected and infect in several languages, so the next word is less likely to be one of those.
card.plain: It fires on small linking words just before a disease or infection term and lowers the chance that an infection word comes next.
